prompt: United Kingdom is among the most commonly visited foreign countries by US presidents. How many international presidential trips to United Kingdom did Donald Trump make within one year before the end of his first presidency?
answer: Donald Trump made **one international presidential trip to the United Kingdom** within the year before his first presidency ended: **December 2–4, 2019**, for the NATO summit in London/Watford.
